# Grand Rising Behavioral Health

> A comprehensive mental health treatment center in Norwood, Massachusetts offering evidence-based therapy and medication management for PTSD, depression, anxiety, and trauma recovery.

Grand Rising Behavioral Health specializes in multiple levels of psychiatric care including Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP), Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP), and outpatient services. The center serves the greater Boston area with a focus on trauma-informed care using modalities such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT.

## Key Topics

- PTSD Treatment
- Depression Treatment
- Anxiety Treatment
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- DBT (Dialectical Behavior Therapy)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Medication Management
- Bereavement Support
- Trauma-Informed Care
- Individual Therapy
- Massachusetts Mental Health Provider
- Norwood Treatment Center
- Telehealth Services

## Core Services & Treatment

- [Services](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/services): Main services page listing PTSD, depression, anxiety, therapy, and medication management
- [PTSD Treatment](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/ptsd-treatments): PTSD treatment services using EMDR and evidence-based trauma-focused care
- [Depression Treatment](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/depression-treatment): Depression treatment with PHP, IOP, and outpatient levels of care
- [Anxiety Treatment](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/anxiety-treatment): Anxiety treatment using CBT, DBT, and evidence-based therapy approaches
- [Individual Therapy](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/individual-therapy): Individual therapy services with CBT, DBT, and EMDR therapeutic modalities
- [Bereavement Support](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/bereavement-support): Bereavement and grief counseling with trauma-informed support and coping skills
- [Mental Health Support](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/services/mental-health-support): Comprehensive mental health support including PHP, IOP, and telehealth services
- [Medication Management](https://www.grandrisingbehavioralhealth.com/services/medication-management): Psychiatric medication management for anxiety, depression, and PTSD treatment
